_doc: Machine form of the review conditions for open notes published before review conditions carried their own `check` and `driver` (build_trade_idea.py REVIEW_CHECKS_FROM). Keyed by note id; `conditions` lines up with the note's review_conditions[] by position. Every level and every move_start value here is copied from the note's own holds_while text or evidence[] — nothing is re-chosen after the fact. Written once (2026-10-30, LESSONS 6.28); never edited to make a call pass. Read by scripts/daily_thesis_check.py.
